create_DiscretizedLogisticMixture: create a discretized mixture of logistic distributions for pixel-level modeling with configurable components
run_loss2bpt: run loss normalization to convert raw loss values into bits per token
run_wait_for_new_checkpoint: run checkpoint polling to wait for new Orbax checkpoint files with configurable timeout
run_generate_image_grids: run image grid generation from a batch of JAX arrays for visualization
run_detokenize_texts: run detokenization of integer token sequences using a SentencePiece tokenizer
